record_id_from_source_name.description: Extract the registry record id from the source filename (for example 0123LYMREG). Use null if absent.

not_report.description: Set to 'not_report' if the document is not a discharge summary, epicrisis or consultation document. Otherwise use null.

document_date.description: Date the document was issued (discharge date for a discharge summary). Use YYYY-MM-DD when possible.

gender.description: REDCap field `gender`: 0 = female, 1 = male. Use null if not stated.

year_birth.description: REDCap field `year_birth`: year of birth only (four digits). Never output the full date of birth.

reg_biopsydate.description: REDCap field `reg_biopsydate`: date of the diagnostic biopsy, YYYY-MM-DD when possible.

diagnosis_text.description: Final lymphoma diagnosis as written in the document, translated into English (for example 'Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS').

reg_histologic_diagnosis.description: REDCap field `reg_histologic_diagnosis`: 1 = mature B-cell neoplasm, 2 = mature T- or NK-cell neoplasm, 3 = Hodgkin lymphoma.

reg_ecog_ps.description: REDCap field `reg_ecog_ps`: ECOG performance status at diagnosis.

reg_beta_symptoms.description: REDCap field `reg_beta_symptoms`: B symptoms present. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

reg_fever.description: REDCap field `reg_fever`: fever as a B symptom. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

reg_night_sweats.description: REDCap field `reg_night_sweats`. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

reg_weight_loss.description: REDCap field `reg_weight_loss`: weight loss as a B symptom. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

ann_arbor_stage.description: REDCap field `ann_arbor_stage`: Ann Arbor stage I-IV coded 1-4 (ignore A/B, E and X suffixes).

bulky_disease.description: REDCap field `bulky_disease`: bulky disease reported. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

extranodal_involv.description: REDCap field `extranodal_involv`: extranodal involvement other than bone marrow, liver or spleen. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

extranodal_sites_text.description: Extranodal sites involved, as written, in English.

ldh.description: REDCap field `ldh`: LDH at diagnosis (numeric value only).

ldh_upper_normal_limit.description: REDCap field `ldh_upper_normal_limit`: laboratory upper limit of normal for LDH, if stated.

beta2_microglobulin.description: REDCap field `beta2_microglobulin`: beta-2 microglobulin at diagnosis (numeric value only).

hbs_antigen_2.description: REDCap field `hbs_antigen_2`: HBsAg 1 = negative, 2 = positive, 3 = not assessed.

start_date.description: REDCap field `start_date`: start date of first-line therapy, YYYY-MM-DD when possible.

end_date.description: REDCap field `end_date`: end date of first-line therapy, YYYY-MM-DD when possible.

first_line_regimen_text.description: First-line regimen exactly as named (for example 'R-CHOP', 'ABVD', 'BV-AVD'); mapped to REDCap `first_line_regimen` after verification.

number_of_cycle_first_line.description: REDCap field `number_of_cycle_first_line`: number of first-line cycles actually given.

radiotherapy.description: REDCap field `radiotherapy`: radiotherapy given as part of first-line treatment. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

first_line_response.description: REDCap field `first_line_response` after first-line therapy: 1 = CR, 2 = PR, 3 = SD, 4 = PD, 5 = not assessed.

relapse_progression.description: REDCap field `relapse_progression`: relapse or progression documented. REDCap yes/no coding: 1 = yes, 0 = no. Use null if not stated.

date_rel.description: REDCap field `date_rel`: date of relapse or progression, YYYY-MM-DD when possible.

survival_status.description: REDCap field `survival_status` at the document date: 0 = alive, 1 = dead, 2 = lost to follow-up.

text_from_discharge_doc.description: REDCap field `text_from_discharge_doc`: the clinically relevant text (diagnosis, staging, treatment, response) translated into English, with all names, addresses, phone numbers and ID numbers removed.

extraction_confidence.description: Overall confidence that the extracted registry fields are correct and complete: 'high' = text clear and values explicit; 'medium' = some ambiguity; 'low' = text garbled/OCR-poor or key values inferred.

extraction_confidence_reason.description: One short sentence on what made the fields easy or hard to determine.
